title: Paid Work/Codex reset
detail: Tibo (Thibault Sottiaux, @thsottiaux) posted 2026-08-31 02:34 UTC that OpenAI reset usage for all paid ChatGPT Work and Codex subscriptions after hitting 25M active users. Pacific date 30 Aug. Affects early September weekly windows.

title: Fable 5.1 launch
detail: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.1 (and Mythos 5.1) on 1 Sep 2026. Live in Claude Code and the Claude Platform (claude-fable-5-1). Same list price as Fable 5, with cheaper API cache reads.

title: All-user limit reset
detail: ClaudeDevs posted 2026-09-01 18:35 UTC: 'With Fable 5.1 out today, we've also reset 5-hour and weekly limits for all users.' Automatic reset at the Fable 5.1 launch.

title: GPT-6 Astra launch
detail: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra, rolling out to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise and into ChatGPT Work and Codex. Astra usage draws from existing Work/Codex allowances, not a separate Astra quota. API model gpt-6-astra. Official prices later listed as $10/M input, $50/M output, $1/M cached input.

title: Banked reset, no Astra
detail: Tibo: OpenAI would give one banked reset for every day a paid ChatGPT plan did not yet have Astra access, starting that day. First grant landing in about 3 hours. Distinct from the later automatic global reset.

title: Astra-day banked reset
detail: Tibo posted 2026-09-05 00:39 UTC (4 Sep evening PT) that OpenAI would also grant a full banked reset that day to all Plus, Pro and Business users because Astra rolled out ahead of schedule. Lands end of day; new/upgraded accounts created before 8pm PT that day also eligible. A banked reset is saved and redeemed by the user; it also moves the weekly reset date.

title: Global Astra rollout reset
detail: Tibo posted 2026-09-08 04:05 UTC: 'All reset for everyone. Enjoy the week with Astra.' This is an automatic (global) reset applied to eligible paid accounts during the Astra rollout, not a banked reset.

title: Reset all propagated
detail: Tibo posted 2026-09-12 08:09 UTC: 'Reset all propagated. Sweet dreams.' Confirms another automatic reset completed (early hours PT on 12 Sep).

title: Weekly limits to +25%
detail: Effective 14 Sep 2026: Claude Code weekly limits are permanently 25% higher than before the May–Sep promotion, for Pro, Max (later Ultra), Team, and seat-based Enterprise. The temporary +50% weekly boost ended 13 Sep 2026 at 11:59pm PT. Versus the boosted level this is about a 17% reduction (125 vs 150). Five-hour limits were not part of this promotion and stayed at the May doubled level. Announced 29 Aug by @ClaudeDevs, which also said 'Compared to today, this works out to a 17% reduction' (https://x.com/ClaudeDevs/status/2093742322525810912).

title: GPT-6 Sol + Luna launch
detail: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu. API ids gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna. Not yet in regular Chat at launch.

title: Sol launch reset promised
detail: Tibo posted 2026-09-22 04:31 UTC (still Mon 21 Sep evening PT): 'We are almost Tuesday and I promised a reset for Tuesday. Among some other things. See you soon.' Tuesday was 22 Sep, the Sol/Luna launch day. No separate 'propagated' confirmation post was found, so landing is inferred from this announcement.

title: 5-hour limits +20%
detail: ClaudeDevs at the Opus 5.5 launch: 'In Claude Code: 5-hour session limits increase 20% today.' Applies alongside the cheaper Opus 5.5 pricing (limits go ~25% further on that model). Weekly limit size was not described as raised in this post.

title: Opus 5.5 launch
detail: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5, first of the Claude 5.5 family, in Claude Code and the Claude Platform (claude-opus-5-5). Official post: performs at Fable 5.1 level on most work, ~30% faster and ~40% cheaper per task than Opus 5. API $4/M input, $20/M output; cache reads $0.20/M (60% below Opus 5). Became the default for paid plans. ClaudeDevs: because it is priced lower, 'your 5-hour and weekly limits go 25% further.'

title: Opus launch banked reset
detail: ClaudeDevs: Pro, Max, and Team users got a reset available the same day in Settings → Usage, usable any time until 22 Oct 2026. Confirmed again on 28 Sep (https://x.com/ClaudeDevs/status/2104641323198472430). Official Opus 5.5 blog also says subscription users received a rate-limit reset they can save and use when they choose.

title: Post-outage global reset
detail: Tibo posted 2026-09-26 18:17 UTC: 'Resets all propagated. That will be all.' Automatic reset after an outage.

title: Sonnet 5.5 launch
detail: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5.5 on 28 Sep 2026, available in the Claude Platform and Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5). Official: 30%+ faster than Sonnet 5, same $2/$10 list prices, cache reads $0.10/M (half of Sonnet 5), up to 30% less cost per task.

title: Pro 200 cut announced
detail: OpenAI Help Center later documents a September 29 email announcing a lower included Work and Codex allowance for ChatGPT Pro 200. Eligible existing subscribers were to keep the previous allowance through 29 Oct 2026, then move to the lower allowance at the same $200/month price. This planned cut was canceled on 29 Oct (see that row). No official percentage was published.

title: GPT-6.1 Sol launch
detail: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Sol in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu (not in Chat at launch). API gpt-6.1-sol. Standard API prices $2/M input, $0.10/M cached input, $10/M output — one-fifth of Astra's standard input/output prices. Became the main mid-tier Codex model.

title: Global reset, GPT-6 lag
detail: Tibo posted 2026-10-02 21:18 UTC: 'Reset all propagated. Enjoy.' Automatic reset for paid ChatGPT accounts after a GPT-6 slow start.

title: 28-day reset run starts
detail: Tibo posted 2026-10-04 20:33 UTC that over the next 28 days, each day OpenAI would either ship one clear improvement for most Codex/Work users or ship a full reset. Day 1 was 5 Oct (W41); Day 28 fell on 1 Nov (W44). This is the cadence behind most October resets.

title: Auto-review now free
detail: Tibo Day 2 roundup (2026-10-06 20:56 UTC): 'Approve for me (auto-review) is now included and does not use usage. Can be between 2-10% of plan when used.' Auto-review previously counted against the Codex/Work allowance; making it free effectively frees that share of the plan.

title: Day 2 global reset
detail: Tibo posted 2026-10-07 03:35 UTC (6 Oct evening PT) that after a community vote, 'the reset has been processed.' Automatic global reset on Day 2 of the 28-day run.

title: Day 3 banked reset
detail: Tibo Day 3 (2026-10-07 19:19 UTC): 'Loading a banked reset in everyone's paid accounts.' Confirmed landed across all accounts at 2026-10-08 03:44 UTC (https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2108040921044639779). Banked, not automatic.

title: Haiku 5.5 launch
detail: Anthropic launched Claude Haiku 5.5 on 7 Oct 2026 (claude-haiku-5-5), a fast small model for high-volume/subagent work, with much lower API prices than Haiku 4.5. Same day, Sonnet 5.5 cache-read price was cut to $0.10/M. ClaudeDevs later clarified that cache-read cut is 'API only, no change to Claude Code usage limits' (https://x.com/ClaudeDevs/status/2108287358374482381).

title: Day 6 global reset
detail: Tibo Day 6 (2026-10-10 22:15 UTC): 'Day 6/ Reset'. Automatic reset in the 28-day run.

title: Day 8 global reset
detail: Tibo posted 2026-10-13 01:03 UTC (12 Oct evening PT): 'Day 8/ Reset'. Automatic reset; Pacific date 12 Oct, start of W42.

title: Gemini 4 Argon launch
detail: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon on 13 Oct 2026. Available to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity, and to Ultra and Pro in the Gemini app. Introductory API price $2/M input and $10/M output until 30 Nov 2026, then $4/$20. Official post does not announce a numeric Ultra quota change at launch.

title: Day 10 global reset
detail: Tibo posted 2026-10-15 04:55 UTC (14 Oct evening PT): 'Day 10/ Reset'. Automatic reset. Pacific date 14 Oct.

title: Day 13 global reset
detail: Tibo Day 13 (2026-10-17 16:20 UTC): 'Day 13/ Le limit reset'. Automatic reset.

title: Day 15 global reset
detail: Tibo posted 2026-10-20 06:33 UTC (19 Oct evening PT): 'Day 15/ Nevermind, we're still cooking... and reset. Enjoy.' Automatic reset. Pacific date 19 Oct.

title: Day 17 global reset
detail: Tibo posted 2026-10-22 06:55 UTC (21 Oct evening PT): 'Day 17/ Bet you thought we forgot, but no, it's reset day today.' Automatic reset. Pacific date 21 Oct.

title: Day 18 global reset
detail: Tibo posted 2026-10-23 04:46 UTC (22 Oct evening PT): '...But yes... that's a reset!' Automatic reset. Pacific date 22 Oct.

title: Day 20 global reset
detail: Tibo posted 2026-10-25 03:39 UTC (24 Oct evening PT): 'Day 20/ Rest and reset', and immediately 'By midnight PST'. Automatic reset. Pacific date 24 Oct.

title: GPT-6.1 Terra launch
detail: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu. API gpt-6.1-terra. Standard API prices $1/M input, $0.05/M cached input, $5/M output (half of GPT-6.1 Sol). Official post: the same usage allowance covers more tasks than with 5.6 Terra and substantially more than with 6.1 Sol or Astra. Tibo the same day: Terra 'gives 2X more usage than 6.1 Sol across API and subscriptions' (https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2114800277677092936).

title: Day 21 global reset
detail: Tibo posted 2026-10-26 05:21 UTC (25 Oct 22:21 PT): 'Day 21/ ... But today is a reset.' Automatic reset on the last day of W43 (Sun 25 Oct PT).

title: Day 23 global reset
detail: Tibo posted 2026-10-28 02:42 UTC (27 Oct evening PT): 'Just kidding, today is a reset.' Landing 'by midnight PST'; confirmed done at 2026-10-28 06:29 UTC (https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2115330127886463244). Automatic reset. Pacific date 27 Oct.

title: Pro 200 cut canceled
detail: Tibo Day 25 (2026-10-29 16:56 UTC): OpenAI is 'doubling all usage limits for all Pro 100/200/500 tiers and Business Premium, effective today,' and 'won't be reducing usage limits for Pro 200, so your Work and Codex usage will stay the same.' OpenAI Help Center: the 29 Sep Pro 200 reduction is canceled; if you already had the higher Work and Codex allowance you keep it; if you had the lower allowance it doubled to match. Pro 100 and Pro 500 now include twice their previous Work and Codex allowance. Plus unchanged. Chat GPT-6 Pro message limits are separate. Existing Pro 200 (the $200 plan) did not get a cut on 29 Oct.

title: Max 20x becomes Ultra
detail: Official @claudeai post 2026-10-30 17:29 UTC: Max 5x is renamed Max ($100); Max 20x is renamed Ultra ($200). Existing subscribers move automatically with no price change. Weekly limits remain unchanged. Starting that day, the 5-hour limit is removed for verified Ultra accounts (most existing subscribers first; newer accounts keep a temporary limit until verified). Help Center: Ultra is 10x the Pro weekly usage; verified Ultra has no five-hour limit. Felipe's plan is this $200 tier.

title: Banked reset 1/2
detail: Tibo posted 2026-11-01 00:43 UTC (31 Oct 17:43 PT): 'Banked 1/2'. First of two banked resets flagged on Day 26 (https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2116405414921384099). Saved to the account until redeemed or expired; not an automatic refresh. Pacific date 31 Oct.

title: Banked reset 2/2
detail: Tibo posted 2026-11-01 23:27 UTC (1 Nov afternoon PT): 'Day 28/ Banked 2/2'. Second banked reset, closing the 28-day run. No confirmed Codex reset from Tibo or OpenAI Developers was found between this post and 12 Nov 21:00 UTC.

title: Fable 5.2 launch
detail: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on 9 Nov 2026, in the Claude Platform and Claude Code. Up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1; API $8/M input and $40/M output (down from $10/$50). Optional fast mode at $16/$80. Official post also points users to Opus 5.5 as the daily driver for most work.

title: Fable 5.2 launch resets
detail: Launch offer for eligible paid plans: Max/Ultra and Team/Enterprise premium seats get 1–3 Fable limit resets by subscription length (<6mo: 1; 6–12mo: 2; >12mo: 3), expiring 8 Mar 2027 11:59pm PT. A Fable reset restores weekly usage spent on Fable models only, and refills any five-hour window (verified Ultra has no five-hour window). It does not raise limits. Billing must have been in place before 9 Nov 2026 10:00am PT. Official help: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17506494-claude-fable-5-2-launch-offers

title: Full reset thru Dec 10
detail: ClaudeDevs posted 2026-11-10 21:59 UTC: all Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team users received one free full reset across all models and limits, usable any time before 10 Dec 2026 at 2:00pm PT, in Settings > Usage or clau.de/reset. Reason given: 'We recently fixed a few small issues that used more limits than intended, and the Fable resets didn't do much for those of you who'd already hit your weekly limits for all models.' This is a banked full reset, not an automatic refresh, and is broader than a Fable-only reset. Expires 10 Dec 2026 2:00pm PT.

title: Gemini 4 Carbon launch
detail: Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon on 10 Nov 2026 for paying API developers and for all Google AI Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity, the Gemini app, and AI Mode in Search. Same introductory API price as Argon ($2/$10 until 30 Nov, then $4/$20). Official post describes Carbon as using more tokens than Argon for deeper reasoning.

title: Banked reset hinted
detail: Tibo posted 2026-11-11 06:55 UTC 'It's been a while without resets. Maybe I should come back out of the basement,' then 06:57 UTC: 'Thursday is feeling codexy to me. Perhaps also a good time for a banked reset.' Thursday was 12 Nov. This is a hint, not an announcement: no plan list, time, or later confirmation post was found as of 12 Nov 21:00 UTC. Do not mark as a landed reset unless a later confirmation appears.

title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen launch
detail: Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen on 12 Nov 2026, including in Google Antigravity, as a faster model for everyday coding and agentic work, alongside Orchestrator for multi-model planning with Carbon. Official Antigravity changelog lists it as a 12 Nov model launch.
